details: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, and crypto exchange OKX have formed a 50-50 joint venture. This partnership aims to build next-generation infrastructure for tokenized and digitally native financial products. Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo will co-chair the venture, which seeks to provide OKX customers with access to ICE futures and NYSE tokenized equities markets.
title: ICE and OKX Partner for Tokenized Equities Infrastructure

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) announced that as of June 21, 2026, it holds 5,672,956 Ethereum tokens, contributing to approximately $10.7 billion in total assets. Bitmine, alongside SharpLink and Ethereum co-founder Joe Lubin, is supporting the newly formed Ethlabs nonprofit. This initiative aims to advance Ethereum's next phase of institutional adoption and development.
title: Bitmine Reports $10.7B in Assets, Backs Ethlabs for Ethereum Growth

details: Strategy (MSTR) reported on June 22, 2026, that it sold 2,714,839 shares of its Class A common stock, generating $335.5 million. The company utilized a portion of these proceeds to acquire an additional 520 Bitcoins, bringing its total holdings to 847,363 BTC. Additionally, Strategy increased its cash reserves by $300 million to $1.4 billion, indicating a strategic focus on liquidity alongside its continued Bitcoin accumulation.
title: Strategy Buys 520 Bitcoins, Increases Cash Reserves

details: Bank of America Global Research has predicted three interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve in September, October, and December. This hawkish monetary policy outlook has introduced jitters into the Bitcoin market, as tighter policy can potentially exert pressure on risk assets such as cryptocurrencies.
title: Bank of America's Rate Hike Forecast Sparks Bitcoin Jitters

details: MoneyGram has expanded its blockchain strategy by taking on a validator role within the Solana network and joining the Solana Developer Platform. This move signifies growing institutional involvement with Solana and is aimed at enhancing MoneyGram's blockchain-based payment services.
title: MoneyGram Becomes Solana Validator, Joins Developer Platform

details: The Bank of England has issued its policy statement and a draft Code of Practice for systemic stablecoin issuers in the UK. This framework is designed to promote trusted UK-issued stablecoins, which could lead to faster and more affordable digital payment services. The framework is expected to be finalized by the end of 2026, with stablecoins operating under these regulations starting in 2027.
title: Bank of England Publishes Stablecoin Regulatory Framework

details: Solana (SOL) experienced a 4% price surge, reaching $71.47, following Morgan Stanley's amended S-1 filing for a spot Solana ETF. The filing included a low sponsor fee and named specific staking providers. This development, coupled with robust ecosystem metrics and a broader crypto market rebound that saw $3 million in ETF inflows and $16.55 million in whale purchases, contributed significantly to SOL's rally.
title: Solana Surges on Morgan Stanley ETF Progress and Ecosystem Growth
